extension.description: Reviews everyday Git porcelain plus local and remote operations that can discard work, replace history, refresh a remote Guard cannot verify, or read a staged index Guard cannot bound.
extension.name: Git protection

permissions.label: Git add
safer_guidance: Inspect the current branch and working tree before changing them.

permissions.label: Forced Git push
safer_guidance: Use `--force-with-lease` after fetching and reviewing the remote ref.

permissions.description: Identifies staged-index Git reads that Guard cannot verify as a bounded inspection.
permissions.label: Git index inspection
safer_guidance: Run git diff --cached --check, or exclude lockfiles and scan the staged patch on stdin.

permissions.label: Local Git branch deletion
